data.name: Ansyak
data.gender_notes: Ansyak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ansyak is a Sanskrit name derived from Ansh, meaning the divine presence or the deity within. The name is a reverence to the supreme power or the divine self within an individual. The name Ansyak carries the meaning “Lord Ansh” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansyak usually hope their child will grow to embody lord ansh and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansyak total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Anishakti, another name for Goddess Parvati, is believed to be the embodiment of divine power or Shakti. She is the consort of Lord Shiva and represents the creative, destructive, and preserving energies of the universe. The name Anishakti is derived from the Sanskrit words 'anisha' meaning 'beyond measure' and 'kshakti' meaning 'power'. This name emphasizes Parvati's infinite and all-powerful nature.
